answer: Make standing depend on a loan thread one owner services: the registry deals 40 micro-loans of $25 in sequence, each to a different borrower from a garden of strangers, each repayment posted to a mirror ledger unlocks the next loan, so no clone can reuse a repayment or run in parallel. A default slashes a $150 bond and restarts the thread. Full weight needs all 40 repaid over 120 days. Scaling to ten thousand fakes would demand 400,000 distinct loans, $10,000,000 in loaned capital and $1,500,000 in bonds at risk; no finished thread can be bought, since every loan is keyed to one identity.
